headline: City vs Newcastle: Haaland leads 5-0-0 leaders into Matchweek 6 clash at Etihad
whyCareReason: Manchester City seek to maintain their 100% record as Erling Haaland faces Newcastle United in Saturday's headline Premier League Matchweek 6 encounter.
teaser: Saturday 26 September, 17:30 BST at Etihad Stadium. Pep Guardiola's 15-point leaders host Matthias Jaissle's Magpies. Live on Sky Sports.
story:
Why this one matters: Premier League Matchweek 6 headlines Saturday 26 September with table-topping Manchester City hosting Newcastle United at the Etihad Stadium.

City enter with a spotless record of five wins from five, having outgunned Sunderland 5-3 in Matchweek 5 behind Antoine Semenyo's double and Erling Haaland's league-leading finish. Pep Guardiola's side holds a three-point cushion over second-placed Arsenal.

Newcastle arrive eager to rebound under manager Matthias Jaissle following an inconsistent start to the campaign. With Arsenal and Brighton applying relentless pressure from behind, City cannot afford complacency against the Magpies' counter-attacking threat.
stakes: City aim for six consecutive victories to cement their place at the summit of the Premier League.
rivalryAngle: Guardiola's machine against Newcastle's resilient defense in a classic northern England clash.
